title: China Lop Nur military expansion — 60,000 sq ft hangar, J-36 testing (satellite imagery)
snippet: Construction activity at Lop Nur base began August 2025. By February 2026, added 60,000 sq ft of hangar space and over 300,000 sq ft of facility space. Construction coincides with 6th-gen J-36 stealth fighter bomber first spotted at the base. Chengdu plant running 5 production lines for J-20, estimated 100-120/year.
